outcome: Postpartum complications (intrapartum stillbirth, maternal death, uterine rupture, postpartum hemorrhage, sepsis)
cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with obstructed labor who underwent emergency cesarean section at 54 referral hospitals in Nigeria between September 1, 2019, and August 31, 2020
finding: The study found a 1.7% prevalence of obstructed labor, with younger age, lack of education, unemployment, nulliparity, and inadequate antenatal care being significant risk factors.
